$comment: Definitions and local snapshot. pnpm task:* uses origin/agent-tasks as the atomic shared claim ledger. Status: todo | claimed | in_review | done. Blockers use blocked_reason.

tasks.title: Guard against horizontal overflow on phones
acceptance: A @smoke Playwright test loads /, /invite, /order, /checkin, /kitchen, /admin and /dev/theme at 375px wide and asserts document scrollWidth <= clientWidth on each
The test runs as part of pnpm test:e2e:smoke (mobile project)
pnpm verify passes

tasks.title: Prove the theme contrast gate end to end
acceptance: A unit test shows that registering a theme which fails WCAG AA throws at module load with a message naming the theme id and every failing token pair
docs/theming.md steps are followed literally to add a temporary third theme in a scratch test, and any inaccuracy in the doc is fixed
pnpm verify passes

tasks.title: Verify database bootstrap is idempotent
acceptance: pnpm db:migrate run twice in a row succeeds with no changes on the second run
pnpm db:seed run twice yields identical row counts (110 invitations, 200-300 guests, 28 tables, 16 menu items)
Every public table has row-level security enabled (checked by a script or SQL query recorded in docs/progress.md)
pnpm verify passes

tasks.title: Confirm CI parity with pnpm verify
acceptance: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs exactly `pnpm verify` (no extra or missing stages) plus the database job
Every env var CI sets is documented in .env.example
Any drift found is fixed and noted in docs/progress.md

tasks.title: UI review of /dev/theme in every theme and width
acceptance: The ui-reviewer subagent reviews /dev/theme and / at 375, 768 and 1280px in both themes
Every Blocker or Should-fix finding is fixed, or recorded in docs/progress.md with a reason
pnpm verify passes

tasks.title: Add frontend design rules for all AI agents
acceptance: Canonical design principles and pass/fail UI checklist exist.
src/AGENTS.md is at most 40 lines and links to the full rules.
Root and existing agent entrypoints link to the shared docs; definition of done includes the checklist.
No existing components or pages change; pnpm verify passes.
tasks.blocked_reason: Previous verification hit local Turbopack port-binding restrictions; rerun before completion.

tasks.title: Upgrade agent harness for two-person parallel work
acceptance: Portable skills and shared hooks are wired for Codex, Claude and Cursor.
Remote task claims reject duplicate/concurrent claims without touching unrelated files.
Managed worktrees isolate Supabase data and server ports; reset/removal never affect another stack.
Onboarding, ownership, plugin, PR and branch-protection tooling are documented and validated.
Full verification and disposable worktree lifecycle pass; external prerequisites are reported accurately.
tasks.blocked_reason: Implementation and isolated integration checks pass. Primary checkout still fails Turbopack local port binding; no origin remote exists for a real claim/PR. See progress log for evidence and owner setup.
